species_environment_summary.occurrence_weighting: equal species weighting at clade stage
species_environment_summary.species_axis_summary: median environmental value across retained occurrences

clade_environment_heterogeneity.standardization: z-score each environmental axis across all matched species before clade aggregation
clade_environment_heterogeneity.centroid: coordinate-wise clade median in standardized 3-axis space
clade_environment_heterogeneity.metric: median Euclidean distance of species environmental centroids from clade centroid

primary_test.outcome: fine visible flower-color signed excess-retention area

secondary_diagnostics: fine visible flower-color decay slope versus abiotic heterogeneity
axis-specific heterogeneity for temperature, aridity, and UV-B
claim_boundary: retrospective moderator analysis because memory outcomes are already known
association does not establish abiotic selection as causal
no pollinator or disperser mechanism is inferred
secondary axes cannot rescue a failed primary composite test
